label: Smart Building Simulation
info:
Managed by GitOps: this flow is rendered from k8s/base/iot/nodered/flows.json into a ConfigMap and copied into /data/flows.json
on every pod start. UI edits are lost on restart on purpose - change the file in git instead.

Device access tokens come from the Secret iot-credentials via ${TB_TOKEN_*} environment variables;
TB_HOST defaults to http://thingsboard:9090 (in-cluster service).

name: 4 simulated devices -> ThingsBoard HTTP telemetry every 5s. Ap2 runs hot (>28C triggers High Temperature), the fuel tank drains 100->0 (<20% triggers Low Fuel).
Data gen - Ap1 Thermostat
Data gen - Ap2 Thermostat
Data gen - Ap3 Thermostat
Data gen - Fuel Tank
